provenance_note: Library base candidate inspected for archive integrity only; it is an APKVISION-repackaged package, not a clean publisher base and not the installed APK.
decisions: Archive-level ZIP integrity passes; this does not establish APK signature validity or Android installability.
The presence of APKVISION signature metadata and this filename identify the supplied input as a distributor-repackaged candidate; do not describe it as a clean authorized base.
Do not remove distributor/license-check code or bypass anti-tamper. Use a clean authorized base and compatible signing provenance for a distributable build.
